page.title: PLEASE START HERE: the emphasis Neave set and the site lost
page.standfirst_html:
The checker reports 43 lost runs on index, plus 1 added and 1 swapped. Each was checked against the source page image. Decisions were delegated by Lee on 2026-09-25, so this record is evidence rather than a review request.

After the pass: 4 lost, 1 added, 0 swapped, all five cleared below as the site's adapted text (#802).

sections.title: Lost emphasis, straight restoration
sections.note_html: Italics in the source, plain on the site, restored as printed. Also the bold The “Overture” cross-reference and the bold-italic Statistics? heading.
